title: CV Tutorial chapters 22–28 — claim/source register
scope: Primary papers and official docs. Figures and runnable samples are illustrative (教学示意), not benchmarks. No dataset-level mIoU/PQ numbers are asserted here.

entries.claim: FCN replaces the classifier's fully connected layers with convolutions to emit dense per-pixel predictions, but retains downsampling so the prediction is coarse before upsampling
entries.caveat: The ~1/32 output stride is the VGG-based FCN example, not a universal constant

entries.claim: Dilated/atrous convolution keeps the parameter count fixed while the effective kernel grows as k_eff = k + (k-1)(d-1)
entries.caveat: Still cross-correlation (no kernel flip); padding must equal the dilation rate to keep output size

entries.claim: DeepLab v3 ASPP defaults to parallel 1x1, multiple dilation rates (commonly 6/12/18) and a global-average-pooling branch, concatenated and fused by 1x1 conv
entries.caveat: Rate set and output channels are implementation/crop-size choices; gridding motivates hybrid rates

entries.claim: SegNet decodes with pooling indices; PSPNet uses a pyramid pooling module over 1x1/2x2/3x3/6x6 grids; DeepLab v3+ adds a light decoder over ASPP
entries.caveat: Comparisons are qualitative here; CRF post-processing belongs to DeepLab v1/v2 and was dropped by v3

entries.claim: Panoptic segmentation assigns every pixel a class label plus an instance id for countable things, with stuff carrying only a class label and no overlaps
entries.caveat: Merging instance and semantic outputs needs a fusion/dedup step; it is not a plain union

entries.claim: Panoptic Quality PQ = SQ x RQ, with SQ the mean IoU over true positives and RQ = TP / (TP + 0.5*FP + 0.5*FN); a predicted/gt segment is a TP only if class matches and IoU > 0.5
entries.caveat: Threshold, empty-segment handling and stuff scoring are part of the protocol; the page's PQ numbers are toy 教学示意

entries.claim: SAM is promptable (points/boxes/masks), uses a heavy image encoder, a light prompt encoder and a light mask decoder, and returns multiple ambiguity-aware masks
entries.caveat: Class-agnostic: it does not output class names; prompt-free use requires an automatic mask-generation pass

entries.claim: SA-1B is reported as ~11M images and ~1.1B masks
entries.caveat: Paper-reported dataset scale; not recomputed here

entries.claim: MixUp takes a convex combination of an image pair with the same coefficient lambda applied to one-hot labels; lambda is drawn from Beta(alpha, alpha)
entries.caveat: Runnable page snippet is a pure-python toy implementation (教学示意), not the paper's full training recipe

entries.claim: CutMix pastes a rectangular patch from one image onto another and mixes labels by the pasted area ratio; CutOut occludes a square on a single image with an unchanged label
entries.caveat: No numeric accuracy gains are asserted

entries.claim: AutoAugment searches augmentation policies with reinforcement learning; RandAugment reduces the search to two hyperparameters (num_ops, magnitude)
entries.caveat: num_ops=2 / magnitude=9 are stated as torchvision defaults, not paper constants

entries.claim: Focal Loss multiplies cross-entropy by a modulating factor (1-p_t)^gamma with a class-balancing weight alpha_t; gamma=0 reduces to weighted cross-entropy
entries.caveat: gamma/alpha are task-dependent; the page's loss values are toy 教学示意

entries.claim: Normalization uses per-channel dataset statistics; ImageNet mean/std are the common default for natural images and are not appropriate for CT/multispectral inputs
entries.caveat: Exact values attributed to the torchvision Normalize documentation example

entries.claim: Albumentations is designed around joint, synchronized transforms of image plus mask/bboxes/keypoints
entries.caveat: Library code shown is illustrative (需安装依赖), not executed in the page

entries.claim: Convolutional networks learn a hierarchy of features: shallow layers detect generic edges/textures and transfer well, deeper layers encode task-specific semantics
entries.caveat: Qualitative claim; the page states no downstream accuracy numbers

entries.claim: ImageNet-1K is ~1.28M images / 1000 classes; ImageNet-21K is ~14M images / ~21841 classes
entries.caveat: Dataset scale figures; exact totals vary by release and are given as approximate

entries.claim: Adapters insert per-layer bottleneck modules and tune only those, reaching close to full fine-tuning at a small fraction of parameters
entries.caveat: The '1-5% params / 95% performance' style figures are not restated here

entries.claim: LoRA freezes W and learns a low-rank update delta_W = B A with scaling (alpha/r); it can be merged back into W for inference
entries.caveat: Page runnable sample is a pure-python 教学示意 of the shapes and forward pass, not the paper's training results

entries.claim: Catastrophic forgetting and discriminative learning rates: overly large updates overwrite pretrained knowledge
entries.caveat: Concept-level claim; the specific learning-rate ranges are starting-point suggestions, not universal constants

entries.claim: Self-supervised pretraining (DINO, MAE) yields representations competitive with supervised pretraining
entries.caveat: Competitiveness is described qualitatively; no mIoU/AP numbers are asserted

entries.claim: Affine quantization maps reals to integers via q = round(x/S) + Z and dequantizes as x_hat = S(q - Z); symmetric quantization sets Z=0
entries.caveat: Per-step rounding error is ~S/2; page runnable sample is a toy 教学示意

entries.claim: PTQ calibrates with a small dataset; QAT inserts fake-quant ops during training
entries.caveat: No specific accuracy-drop or compression numbers are asserted

entries.claim: Unstructured pruning yields sparse matrices that rarely speed up dense hardware; structured/channel pruning yields smaller dense models that do
entries.caveat: Channel importance via BN scaling factor attributed to Network Slimming; no pruning ratios fixed here

entries.claim: Knowledge distillation trains a student on the teacher's temperature-softened output; loss combines KL on soft labels with CE on hard labels, weighting the KL term by T^2
entries.caveat: The T^2 factor compensates the 1/T^2 gradient scale; the page's softmax numbers are toy 教学示意

entries.claim: Deployment exports models to ONNX or TorchScript; engines such as TensorRT fuse operators (e.g. Conv+BN+ReLU) for speed
entries.caveat: Engine capabilities described from official docs; no latency speedups asserted

entries.claim: SimCLR maximizes agreement of two augmented views with the NT-Xent loss; negatives come from the batch, so it depends strongly on batch size
entries.caveat: MathML states the NT-Xent form; no top-1 accuracy numbers are asserted

entries.claim: MoCo keeps a queue of historical negatives and a momentum (EMA) encoder to decouple the negative pool from batch size
entries.caveat: Momentum/batch-size coupling described qualitatively; no numbers fixed

entries.claim: MAE masks ~75% of patches, encodes only visible patches, and reconstructs all patches with a light decoder; loss is computed on masked patches
entries.caveat: High mask ratio is motivated by image spatial redundancy; the page's mask sample is a toy 教学示意 (14x14 patches)

entries.claim: DINO is self-distillation with no labels (EMA teacher, shared architecture) and its ViT attention reveals emergent object segmentation; iBOT combines self-distillation with masked image modeling
entries.caveat: The emergent-attention claim is qualitative; linear-probe percentages are not restated

entries.claim: CLIP trains an image and a text encoder with contrastive learning over image-text pairs and enables zero-shot classification via class-name prompts
entries.caveat: Known limits (fine-grained, compositionality) are qualitative; dataset size not restated

entries.claim: SAM is promptable (points/boxes/masks) and class-agnostic; its image encoder is ViT-based
entries.caveat: Cross-references chapter 22 for architecture details; no metrics asserted
